note: Marisa's own hat turned upside down with its soft crown pressed flat: the cradle on land and the boat afloat. Model units (16 per block) at growth 1. The hat is the worn hat copied box for box with a well opened in it; these are the opening's wall, how far the crown is pressed, the aquatic hat's size, the young's places, how a helper is placed, and the pregnant body used to find the live exit.
lore: user 2026-10-15: turned over, the hat's soft top gives like a nest (a likeness); just turn the hat upside down and squash its bottom, without turning it into another shape

front_tread.note: Keep solid cloth inside the original base tier at the front; a shallow child foothold connected to the crown wall, above the deep central well. Project design 2026-10-26 (aquatic deck): 2.01 hat units deep (was 1.66) so a 0.40 child sits on it before the owner by night; 0.6 below the brim (was 1.1) so a baby there shows its face over the bow rim from the bank (lead review of the shore view).

aquatic_scale_lore: the aquatic Marisa's hat is larger than a land Marisa's so it carries her young and food as a small dry boat (user, 2026-10-14)

nest.lore: on the ground the crown is pressed until the turned-over hat stands this high on it, low enough that a newborn pushed out of the live exit clears the near brim on a short arc

bowl.squash_lore: Project design 2026-10-26 (lead review of the shore view): afloat the crown is pressed flatter (0.75 -> 0.55) so the cavity floor rises and the larder and young read from the bank; the crown is under water and the brim, band and look are unchanged.
bowl.lore: afloat the crown, pressed a little, hangs under the water (EH22); the owner rests at the stern on the ledge in the opening; by day the young ride on the floor before her, at night under her (user, 2026-10-14)

grip_lore: on the head the braid hooks one brim point on its own side (saved braid interactions v2 take the hat by one brim point), chosen so it is also in reach when the turned-over hat is pressed down and the hat turned so that point comes toward the braid; set down, the braid holds the brim just outside the opening

float.lore: at a bank the aquatic Marisa catches in her hat floated at the water's edge before the outlet, its near brim slipped under the bank; a newborn pushed too hard flies past it into the river (user, 2026-10-14). bank_drop: the water surface below the bank top

helper.lore: the helper keeps clear of the swollen mother and of the hat's brim (user 2026-10-15: the father stood too close and went through), holds the brim on her braid side and looks toward the outlet; the brim point the braid holds stays out of the newborn's path (corridor: half width beside the outlet line)

pregnancy.lore: LiveBirthGeometry.deform; used for the live exit (the body's half width at a full belly)

brim_standing.lore: User 2026-10-16: small juveniles stand on their floating parent's brim. The whole body footprint must fit the front and forward-side brim, with space for each worn hat; eating, sleeping and danger send them inside. The first voyage starts in small childhood at scale 0.20 (project balance), after solid feeding, jumping and learning are available, from a parent's hat and back to a reserved berth. After the lesson, young live and sleep in their own hats near the parent, observe and practise, and return inside the parent hat for protection. Leaving the family remains a separate subadult transition. Preview siblings use actual early-juvenile scales 0.20-0.25.

delivery.gravity_lore: Minecraft's 0.08 blocks per tick squared, in model units
delivery.gap_lore: between the live exit (the newborn's round body) and the near brim: a helper sets the hat this far out; a mother on her own sets it as far as her braid reaches (the first that fits)
delivery.lore: user 2026-10-15: the young clipped into the hat on land, the stem young's fall swerved and the bank arc was wrong; newborns now fly true arcs under gravity over the brim, stem fruit drop straight and bounce in from the brim or the ground, and each young sits apart (round body, radius young_radius of its collision width)

deck.lore: Project design (aquatic rework, lead decisions 2026-10-26 from the ecology design): the seat table is the one authority on space and the load only sets draft and stability (A1); the freeboard sinks with load (A3); a high stern seat frees the front cavity in late pregnancy (A5); the stick stows on the left outer brim, away from the owner's right braid (A9); no provisions on the brim, the whole store lies in the crown cavity and children sit in the cabin (user 2026-10-26).
deck.classes_lore: Largest body of each class relative to the hull's hat fit: live newborn 0.14 and baby to 0.20 (family.json growth); small child to 0.30 and children to 0.45 (ecology design A1), split at 0.40 where the cabin stops holding a child before the owner by night; above 0.45 not a regular passenger (rescue rim only). The owner 1.0; gravid at a full belly (recipe pregnancy). A body takes the smallest class at least its relative size.

paddle.lore: fallback only: the stowed stick is taken from paddle_stick.json anchors.stow_hull (interactions/aquatic-tools), on the left outer brim away from the owner's right braid (D A9)

hop_rim.lore: a parabola under Minecraft gravity (delivery.gravity) clearing the brim by delivery.clear, at least delivery.hop_tmin ticks

climb_rim.lore: ruling water 11: bite the brim, hook the braid over it, pull the body up and slide over the rim; braidless kinds use the mouth only

lift.lore: the parent's braid tip curls into a cradle under the body (mouth for braidless kinds); the carried body rides as a hull passenger while it moves

deck.night_lore: user 2026-10-14 (recipe bowl): by day the young ride before her, at night under her; a young may lie beneath the owner when its whole body and worn hat stay below her
deck.young_hat_lore: Project design (lead review 2026-10-26, shore view): a young aquatic Marisa still in her mother's hat wears a land-size hat (x1.0); the 1.75 hat at a young's size hid its whole face and filled the cabin. Its own boat-size hat comes with the first voyage (HatVessel.hatMultiplier must follow).
deck.owner_hat_gap_lore: Project design (preview review 2026-10-26): a young's own hat cleared the owner's bounds by the plain gap but met her hair and face as drawn; hats keep this berth from the owner.

crew.lore: Project design (ecology design D 3.4): which clip and face each body aboard shows for where it sits and the time of day; the server picks from this table (clips and faces are server-chosen, the client never overrides them while the hull rocks). A young keeps its seat's yaw (the deck's conflicts are measured with it): by day the bow perch prefers places facing out over the bow, by night places facing the owner. Faces left out are the clip's own. Only what a player sees from the bank or alongside is dressed: young asleep under the owner show the tops of their hats.

night_with_young.when: a young sits in NEST_HOLLOW or WELL_FRONT

threat.when: rain or a shadow overhead with young aboard
